x: Dr. Kevin Reynolds, O.D. Dr. Kevin Reynolds was born and raised in Dumas which is a small town in the Texas panhandle. After high school graduation he received a BS degree in Biomedical Science from Texas A&M University. He decided to leave Texas for a little adventure and attend Illinois College of Optometry in Chicago, IL. After he received his Doctor of Optometry degree in 2009, he soon realized he missed Texas sunshine and BBQ. He has been practicing in central Texas and enjoys the New Braunfels community that he shares with his family. When not seeing patients, he enjoys snow skiing, traveling with his family, and watching all sports, especially Texas A&M football.

x: Dr. Noemi Lozano, O.D. Dr. Noemi "Mimi" Lozano was born and raised in Corpus Christi, Texas. She attended and enjoyed playing on the lady’s tennis team at the University of Texas at San Antonio. Off the courts, she received her BS degree in Biology. After graduation she worked as an optician and optometry technician, then pursued a career in optometry. She received her Doctor of Optometry degree in 2009 from the University of Houston College of Optometry. She has worked in many optometric settings in central Texas, but most enjoyed practicing at the Veterans Affairs Eye Clinic in Austin. She then decided to move her family to the beautiful, family-oriented town of New Braunfels and began a private practice. When Dr. Lozano is not seeing patients, she enjoys watching her kids play tennis, taking family vacations and exploring new restaurants.
